title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 3 dataset
description: This dataset contains 14-channel Emotiv EPOC EEG recordings from healthy, BCI-naive participants performing a steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) task. Five violet boxes flickered simultaneously at 6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00 and 12.00 Hz while participants focused on a cued target. The recordings come from the MAMEM SSVEP III collection and were used in a comparative evaluation of filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction and classification algorithms for SSVEP-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was sampled at 128 Hz with 14 scalp channels. Each trial was a 5 s flickering window followed by 5 s of rest. Each subject completed a single adaptation period followed by up to 5 sessions of 25 windows each. Preprocessing comprised 5-48 Hz bandpass filtering, a 50 Hz notch filter, artifact removal (AMUSE, ICA) and common average referencing. Stimuli were shown on a 22 inch LCD monitor with a 60 Hz refresh rate.
